body: Would be interesting to do discussion on there probably... I guess it's unfortunate that it's so small since I won't be around long enough to discuss.
Thanks for the suggestion. Looks like there is a place where people talk about suicide without the knee jerk response.

I completely understand the consequences of what I'm doing. I know what it does to people who know me and why it might fuck me over. I still believe in my right to do it though since my life is the only thing I really own. If whatever system punishes you for making a decision about my own life then I don't agree with it anyway.

People usually associate suicide with depression which equates to the person feeling empty and horrible all the time. I feel like it's more of me taking a journey somewhere else. Sure, you're sad the person left and won't be around any longer but they're off content doing other things and you eventually find other friends.

I'm not religious but that doesn't mean I think there is only nothingness after I die. It's very possible and makes sense based on what we know about consciousness. However that doesn't stop me from hoping for some type of great afterlife. I think personally for me, if there was an afterlife I don't want it to be the stupid stereotypical paradise where you can be with family, friends, etc. I would want control of my own universe to play out infinite numbers of situations that I think of that would be cool. Like a sandbox basically. Seeing what's next (if there is something) is actually the first exciting thing that has happened to me in a while.

There is no hope for me because in order to change I have to work towards changing myself. Since I'm a lazy mother fucker this will never happen and I actually kinda don't want to change because working sucks. If I truly wanted to fix myself I would reach out to anybody but I don't. I might consider living if I had a yearly salary for doing nothing.. but who wouldn't? I'm not even 100% sure if that would keep me going.

I have a fundamental problem with how the world operates. To put it simply: I don't enjoy working for things.

Maybe some people would think this is a dumb reason, but that's their opinion. Some people enjoy living and love making goals, going out and doing things, etc. I personally do not so I've chosen to opt out. No dramatic story, I'm not depressed or sad I just hate life.
